description:
Satellite imagery from Spot 5 (2.5 m resolution, 1/2/3 band combination) shows a landscape in the Pineiou Delta, a Natura 2000 (N2K) site in Greece, dated 2011-08-23. The image displays distinct land cover types:
A prominent river, coloured deep blue-green and outlined in bright green, flows vertically on the right side of the image.
To the left of the river, a large, irregularly shaped area of light blue-greyish land is enclosed by a yellow dotted line. This area appears to be flat, potentially wet or muddy, consistent with a transformed salt marsh or sparsely vegetated area.
Further to the left, and extending to the top and bottom, is a reddish-brown textured area, indicative of dry or sparsely vegetated land.
On the right side of the river, several rectangular parcels of land are visible, with varying shades of dark to light blue-green, representing agricultural fields. The image is sourced from CNES 2011©, Distribution Airbus DS/Spot Image.
